about.heading: Dreamlike interiors, painted in oil.
about.p1: Ella Maria Grosz makes vivid, surreal figurative paintings. Empty swimming pools, bathrooms and bedrooms become stages where figures melt into golden liquid, tiles glow, and ordinary rooms tip over into dream.
about.p2: Trained at the HfBK Dresden and the Accademia di Belle Arti di Roma, she moves between fully resolved oil canvases, sepia underpaintings and quick studies on paper. Her work has been shown across Germany and in Rome and Paris. Each painting is an original, available directly from the artist.
